testimonials.author: Rajesh K. Sharma
testimonials.quote: JDC Solar managed our complete PM Surya Ghar subsidy application and JBVNL net-metering without any hassle. Our monthly electricity bill dropped from ₹4,500 to less than ₹500. Highly professional engineering team!

testimonials.author: Anand K. Verma
testimonials.quote: We installed a 250 kWp system on our plant shed. JDC Solar finished execution within 20 days with zero disruption to our manufacturing shifts. The Section 32 tax benefit and bill savings made the payback under 3.5 years.

testimonials.author: Dr. S. Mukherjee
testimonials.systemCapacity: 25 kWp Rooftop Solar with DG Sync
testimonials.quote: Power continuity and clean energy were essential for our MRI and CT scan equipment. JDC Solar's engineering team designed a DG-synchronized plant that slashed our diesel consumption drastically.

testimonials.author: Praveen Tiwari
testimonials.quote: The entire society common area lighting and lift power is now powered 100% by solar. The solar calculator on their website gave us an exact estimate that matched the actual performance.
